pacaso.name: Pacaso
pacaso.h1: Pacaso — The Fractional Co-Ownership Operator Profile [2026]
pacaso.title: Pacaso Co-Ownership Reviewed: Operations, Coverage, Fees, Resale [2026]
pacaso.subtitle: Founded 2020, headquartered in Napa, California. The largest and most operationally polished fractional co-ownership operator by US density, with growing European inventory. 190 COP-listed properties across 6 countries.
pacaso.metaDescription: Operational profile of Pacaso, the US-origin fractional co-ownership operator. Covers geographic coverage, share structure, annual fees, resale process, Pacaso Swap network, financing pathways, and how Pacaso compares to MYNE, Vivla, and other operators.
pacaso.anchorMarkets: US single-family + Mexico second-home + growing European inventory
pacaso.usp: Largest US fractional operator with the most polished digital owner platform, the Pacaso Swap + Infinity exchange network, and the only documented 70% LTV US-buyer financing pathway in the category.

myne.name: MYNE Homes
myne.h1: MYNE Homes — The Fractional Co-Ownership Operator Profile [2026]
myne.title: MYNE Homes Co-Ownership Reviewed: Operations, Coverage, Fees, Resale [2026]
myne.subtitle: Founded 2020, headquartered in Berlin. European-anchored Mediterranean-led fractional operator. 99 COP-listed properties across 9 countries. Operating a German GmbH & Co. KG structure with a 12-month satisfaction guarantee and €99/month service fee.
myne.metaDescription: Operational profile of MYNE Homes, the Berlin-headquartered fractional co-ownership operator. Covers 9-country European coverage, GmbH & Co. KG structure, €99/month service fee, MYNE Owner Service concierge exchange, 12-month satisfaction guarantee, Nordea financing partnership.
myne.rentalPolicy: Permitted subject to local licensing; owner-managed
myne.usp: European-wide network operator with the most consistent legal structure (GmbH & Co. KG) across countries, the only documented 12-month satisfaction-guaranteed fraction exchange in the category, and four-language site support (EN/DE/SE/NL).

vivla.name: Vivla
vivla.h1: Vivla — The Fractional Co-Ownership Operator Profile [2026]
vivla.title: Vivla Co-Ownership Reviewed: Operations, Coverage, Fees, Resale [2026]
vivla.subtitle: Founded 2020, headquartered in Barcelona. The deepest Spain-specialist fractional co-ownership operator. 34 COP-listed properties — all Spanish. Strongest published resale metrics in the category (under 4 weeks average, +11% portfolio appreciation in 2025) and the unique Andbank Lombard financing product.
vivla.metaDescription: Operational profile of Vivla, the Barcelona-headquartered Spain-only fractional co-ownership operator. Covers Spanish SL structure, 1.5–2% annual fee model, three liquidity windows, Vivla Keys exchange system, Andbank Lombard financing, operator-managed rental program.
vivla.anchorMarkets: Mallorca, Marbella, Costa del Sol, Madrid, Barcelona, Canary Islands
vivla.rentalPolicy: Permitted; operator-managed rental program (15% commission, ~25% all-in via Airbnb)
vivla.usp: Spain-only specialist with the deepest Spanish operational knowledge, the strongest published exit-liquidity metrics in the category, and the unique Andbank Lombard loan product (Andbank holds 3% equity in Vivla).

andhamlet.name: &Hamlet
andhamlet.title: &Hamlet Co-Ownership Reviewed: Operations, Coverage, Fees [2026]
andhamlet.subtitle: Norwegian-backed European premium fractional co-ownership operator. 12 COP-listed properties across Spain, France, and Italy. €99/share/month + cost-passthrough fee model. Owner-occupancy only — no rental program — with the most transparent fee disclosure in the category.
andhamlet.metaDescription: Operational profile of &Hamlet, the Norwegian-backed premium European fractional co-ownership operator. Covers Spain/France/Italy inventory, €99/share/month + cost-passthrough fee model, Nordea financing partnership, owner-occupancy-only rental policy, €700k property minimum.
andhamlet.anchorMarkets: Spain (Mallorca, Costa del Sol) + select France and Italy properties
andhamlet.usp: The most transparent fee disclosure model in the category (€99/share/month + cost-passthrough, fully published) and a curated premium portfolio with a €700k minimum property threshold. Backed by Askeladden & Co (Norwegian venture builder).

abitaro.name: Abitaro
abitaro.h1: Abitaro — The Fractional Co-Ownership Operator Profile [2026]
abitaro.title: Abitaro Co-Ownership Reviewed: Operations, US Coverage, Fees [2026]
abitaro.subtitle: Smaller US-focused fractional co-ownership operator. 3 COP-listed properties (all US, Miami-anchored). Marketed 10% targeted returns and a managed rental program. Among the newest and smallest of the operators on the COP marketplace.
abitaro.metaDescription: Operational profile of Abitaro, a smaller US-focused fractional co-ownership operator. Covers Miami-anchored US inventory, marketed 10% targeted returns, share structure, and the operator's minimal published operational documentation.
abitaro.founded: Newer operator (2023+ based on visible operations)
abitaro.usp: US-focused operator marketing 10% targeted returns. Among the newest and smallest of the operators on the COP marketplace, with the least public operational documentation.
